description: Required repository checks. `cargo xtask checks --profile fast` runs the CI set; `extended` needs release builds, openssl, java or time; `qualification` entries point at registered protocols and never report success from the runner. See docs/formal/verification-strategy.md.

checks.scope: Rust formatting of the workspace
checks.unchecked: Formatting only.

checks.scope: Locked compilation of every workspace target
checks.unchecked: Research packages under tools/ are separate workspaces and not compiled.

checks.scope: Workspace unit, integration and end-to-end tests, including the delivery-kernel differential test, the gate fixtures and server tests graded by the Python query oracle
checks.unchecked: Excluded research packages; physical power loss; multi-host networks; qualification workloads.
checks.negative_controls: xtask/tests/gates.rs fixture defects; see xtask/mutants.json for code mutants

checks.scope: Clippy on core, ports and app, including the core's panic and unchecked-arithmetic restrictions
checks.unchecked: Adapters and composition roots are not held to the core's restrictions.

checks.scope: Hexagonal dependency rule over declared and resolved cargo metadata
checks.unchecked: Module-level structure inside a crate; composition roots that still contain adapters.

checks.scope: Core dependency allowlist, denied categories, build script, features, required attributes, syntactic guards, transitive closure
checks.unchecked: Determinism of individual functions; block comments and strings in the source guard.

checks.scope: The qualification runner's limits, ownership marker and negative controls
checks.unchecked: Hard filesystem quotas; environment-scrubbing children.

checks.scope: Seeded source and the independent rate oracle, with injected overrate, corruption and missing-source controls
checks.unchecked: Real Spindle offer timing and end-to-end admission.
checks.fixtures: seed 0xA11FA001, ten identities, two seconds; SHA-256 a6e5fca6...

checks.scope: The independent delivery oracle and its mutation controls
checks.unchecked: The oracle's own adapter contract: it grades transcripts, not processes.
checks.negative_controls: dropped ACKed record, duplicate, replaced bytes, early forget

checks.scope: The independent query and rate oracle and its pagination, rate and completeness mutants
checks.unchecked: Latency and freshness; the oracle is exact-scan only.

checks.scope: Relative links, heading fragments, Mermaid syntax, marked diagram copies, JSON syntax, duplicate ADR numbers
checks.unchecked: Whether prose is true.

checks.scope: The documentation checker's valid and broken fixtures
checks.unchecked: Checker coverage beyond its fixtures.

checks.scope: Codex hook behavior
checks.unchecked: Live hook activation and trust.

checks.scope: Agent-telemetry record contract
checks.unchecked: Development tooling only; no product claim.

checks.scope: Agent-telemetry observer CLI
checks.unchecked: Development tooling only; no product claim.

checks.scope: Every registered semantic mutant must be caught by its named checker
checks.unchecked: Mutants not in the registry; see cargo-mutants calibration.

command: cargo build --release --locked --workspace --bins --examples && for s in clean server-kill node-kill outage; do for seed in 1 2; do python3 -B tools/qualification/delivery_faults.py --scenario $s --seed $seed --seconds 20 || exit 1; done; done && ! python3 -B tools/qualification/delivery_faults.py --scenario clean --seed 3 --seconds 8 --mutate drop-recovered
checks.scope: Real server and Spindle processes under SIGKILL and outage, graded by the delivery oracle, plus the drop-recovered negative control
checks.unchecked: Physical power loss; more than three Spindles; latency.
checks.bounds: three Spindles, 20 s per scenario, seeds 1 and 2

checks.scope: TLC over the delivery ownership model: Safe passes, EarlyAck and LostCopy produce counterexamples
checks.unchecked: The model is not the Rust code; no trace mapping yet.

checks.scope: TLC over the research transport credit model
checks.unchecked: Research model only.

command: echo 'qualification protocol: run by hand under explicit scope (see the protocol; runner.py with history_tier.py)' >&2; exit 3
checks.scope: Registered qualification: docs/experiments/benchmarks/alpha-phase4-history-protocol.md
checks.expected: a run record under the registered protocol; this entry never reports success
checks.unchecked: Everything until a run record exists.
